description: Make the named configVersion of a dataset public: cuts an immutable revision and returns the public API, page and compare URLs plus install notes. Call it only when the user asked for a public comparison. Needs at least two tools with verified plans. Needs a signed-in inite.ai account: a guest call answers 401 and starts the OAuth flow.

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string per intended change (8-128 chars). A retry with the same key and body returns the first answer.
